docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The myths and traditions of the Māori, from the parting of Rangi and Papa to the deeds of Māui and the voyages of the canoes to New Zealand.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

George Grey (1812–1898), Polynesian Mythology, and Ancient Traditional History of the New Zealand Race, 1855, from the narratives of Wiremu Maihi Te Rangikāheke (died 1896) and other Māori authorities. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from the Internet Archive. Modified: converted to this format.
